description: This file defines the TTSConfiguration class responsible for managing text-to-speech settings and configurations, including endpoint URLs, API keys, voice parameters, fallback data, and methods to load, update, and validate configurations.

classes.name: TTSConfiguration
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration parameters for a text-to-speech system, providing methods to set and retrieve various settings such as endpoints, voice, rate, language, and fallback options.

methods.name: setEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the main endpoint URL for the TTS service.

methods.name: setSecureEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the secure (HTTPS) endpoint URL for the TTS service.

methods.name: setApiKey
methods.description: Sets the API key used for authentication with the TTS service.

methods.name: setEndpointType
methods.description: Sets the type of endpoint used for the TTS service.

methods.name: setLocalEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the local endpoint URL for TTS.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the TTS configuration.

methods.name: setPrimVolDuck
methods.description: Sets the primary volume ducking parameter.

methods.name: hasValidLocalEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the local endpoint is valid.

methods.name: setFallBackText
methods.description: Sets fallback data from a FallbackData object.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Returns the speech rate as uint8.

methods.name: primVolDuck
methods.description: Returns the primary volume ducking parameter.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration is enabled.

methods.name: isPreemptive
methods.description: Returns whether preemptive speaking is enabled.

methods.name: updateConfigStore
methods.description: Updates and saves the current configuration to storage.

methods.name: updateWith
methods.description: Updates current configuration with another TTSConfiguration object.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration is valid.
